verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents a native MCP server at the POST /mcp route. Through it, MCP-compatible agents can search indexes, create indexes, add documents, and configure settings such as ranking rules, searchable attributes and faceting. The probe confirms official MCP docs exist. This covers the query and index-operation parts of the story with first-party evidence. missing for 10: evidence that analytics (search events, clicks, conversions) is exposed through the MCP/tool surface, independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server.
